meta.title: Drowned Road
meta.premise: A courier awakens on a flooded road with no memory of the cargo she carries. She must uncover what she bears and why it matters.

entities.name: flooded road
entities.brief: A narrow, waterlogged path cut through the marsh, its surface barely allowing a foothold.

detail.description: The road is awash in murky water, the path barely visible under the reeds. The water swallows the sound of distant traffic, making the world feel still.
detail.hook: A wooden crate drifts nearby, its lid sealed tight, catching your eye.

entities.name: Wooden Crate
entities.brief: A weather‑beaten crate bobbing in the water, its lid sealed tight with a rusted latch.

detail.description: The crate's wood is swollen and cracked, but a faint scent of oil and herbs escapes when a wave lapping it hits the lid.
detail.hook: The latch looks brittle; perhaps a sharp stone could pry it open.

entities.name: Grelkin the Elder Fisherman
entities.brief: A weather‑worn man in soaked boots, his beard tangled with reeds; his eyes scan the water as if seeking something lost.

detail.description: Grelkin clutches a frayed net, its loops tangled with unseen debris. The water's edge mirrors his tired face, and he seems to be waiting for something valuable to surface.
detail.hook: He shouts, "Hey! Could you spare a hand with this?"

threads.title: Lost Cargo
threads.note: The courier awoke with no memory of the cargo she bears; discovering the crate may reveal why it matters.

hooks.note: The courier meets Grelkin, an elder fisherman who may know something about the crate's contents.
